verdict.rationale: Hightouch can be driven headlessly. It has a public REST API over syncs, models, sources and destinations, with bearer-token API keys that can be scoped to limited roles for automated or AI tools. A published OpenAPI 3.0 spec, documented rate limits, and "configure syncs in the app or take control via API" round this out. Git Sync lets workspace resources be managed programmatically, and the company highlights git version control as a developer feature. Missing for 10: an official CLI or documented CI integration (e.g. a GitHub Actions or pipeline recipe), an explicitly documented API call to trigger a sync run, and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
